text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for Rice Shower for
some time
now. As the sun begins to
set...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! I was looking for something at
the park.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I didn't lose anything, but another
girl at
the park did.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She lost her hat and asked me to help
her look for
it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I told her it was bad luck for me to help,
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She kept crying, and there was no one
else
around.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We found it pretty quickly, but
then it got
blown away by the wind, and
it took some time to
get it back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... she was so happy once I gave her
the hat
back... It made me really happy
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, I know that's no excuse for missing
training...
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her she did the right thing, but also
that she
should contact me next time
something like that
happens.
